connectorUiConfig.title: Tenable.io Vulnerability Management (CCF - NON-FUNCTIONAL)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
⚠️ **CRITICAL WARNING: THIS CCF CONNECTOR DOES NOT FUNCTION PROPERLY**

This Codeless Connector Format (CCF) version of the Tenable.io connector has **fundamental architectural limitations** that prevent it from collecting data correctly. **Use the Azure Durable Functions connector instead** (located in the parent directory).

## Why This Connector Cannot Work

Tenable.io uses an asynchronous export job API that is incompatible with CCF:
- Export jobs take minutes/hours to complete
- CCF cannot poll status endpoints until completion
- CCF cannot iterate over dynamically discovered data chunks
- No state management for export job tracking

## Recommended Action

**DO NOT USE THIS CONNECTOR.** Instead, deploy the fully functional Azure Durable Functions connector from the TenableIO solution.

---

[See full technical documentation](https://aka.ms/sentinel-TenableIO-CCF-limitations)

The original [Tenable.io](https://www.tenable.com/products/tenable-io) data connector provides reliable ingestion of Asset and Vulnerability data through Azure Durable Functions. This CCF version exists for reference only.

sampleQueries.query:
TenableIO_Vuln_CL
 | sort by TimeGenerated desc
 | take 10

TenableIO_Assets_CL
 | sort by TimeGenerated desc
 | take 10

dataTypes.name: TenableIO_Vuln_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
TenableIO_Vuln_CL
 | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: TenableIO_Assets_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
TenableIO_Assets_CL
 | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

instructionSteps.title: ⚠️ CRITICAL: Do Not Use This Connector
instructionSteps.description:
This CCF connector **cannot function correctly** due to Tenable.io's asynchronous export API architecture. It will not collect vulnerability or asset data properly.

**Recommended Action:** Use the Azure Durable Functions connector located in the parent directory of this solution. That connector provides full functionality including:
- Proper export job management
- Status polling until completion
- Chunk download and processing
- Error handling and retry logic
- Data partitioning for large payloads

[Deploy the Durable Functions connector](https://aka.ms/sentinel-TenableIO-azuredeploy)

instructionSteps.title: Step 1 - Obtain Tenable.io API Credentials
instructionSteps.description:
Even though this connector won't work correctly, if you proceed, you'll need:

1. Log in to your Tenable.io account
2. Navigate to **Settings** > **My Account** > **API Keys**
3. Click **Generate** to create new API keys
4. Copy both the **Access Key** and **Secret Key**
5. Store them securely (you won't be able to view the Secret Key again)

[Detailed Instructions](https://docs.tenable.com/tenableio/vulnerabilitymanagement/Content/Settings/GenerateAPIKey.htm)

instructionSteps.title: Step 2 - Configure Connection (Non-Functional)
instructionSteps.description: Enter your Tenable.io API credentials. Note: This connector will create export jobs but cannot properly retrieve the data.

instructionSteps.title: Step 3 - Expected Result
instructionSteps.description:
⚠️ **After connecting, you will NOT see data in your tables.**

The connector will:
- ❌ Create export jobs that never complete
- ❌ Fail to poll job status properly
- ❌ Never download actual vulnerability/asset data
- ❌ Leave orphaned export jobs in Tenable.io

**Again: Use the Azure Durable Functions connector for working data collection.**
